content.text: DSM V combined dysthymia & chronic major depressive dx into PDD
*criteria for MDD may be continuously present for 2yrs
majority of the day on most days lasting
never been w.o Sx >2MO @ a time
•combo tx w/ psychotherapy & pharmacology more efficacious than either alone
freq temper outbursts + persistent irritable or angry mood b/n outbursts
•Meds for Sx control & comorbidities (stimulants, mood stabilizers, second-generation antipsychotics); SSRIs only for comorbid anxiety/depression
cluster of physical, behavioral, & mood chgs w/ cyclical occurrence during the luteal phase of the menstrual cycle
*PRESENT wk b4 MENSES ONSET, IMPROVE after a few days of onset, MINIMAL/⍉wk AFTER MENSES ENDS
*must be confirmed by recording of ± 2 CYCLES
(ex, mood swings, suddenly tearful, more sensitive)
mood, feelings of hopelessness, or self-deprecating thoughts
, &/or feelings of being keyed up or
, easily fatigued, or lack of E
breast tenderness/swelling, joint/musc pain, bloating, wt gain
*underlying cause must be ruled out w/
: improves sxs of bloating & tender breasts
